executiveSummary: Dzisiejszy run dołożył nowy board-first burst wokół Addepto, Itransition, EPAM, cloudatus, Accenture i Team Up. Najmocniejsze sygnały to Addepto Senior AI Engineer (LLMs, Python) z jasnym salary bandem, Itransition Agentic Platform Architect jako enterprise-grade agentic AI platform, EPAM Senior AI/ML Solution Engineer (AI Agentic Security Testing) oraz AI Developer with .NET and Microsoft Agent Framework (f/m/x) z Team Up. To przesuwa miks wyraźnie w stronę agentic platform architecture, Microsoft-native delivery, AI security testing i consulting/enablement, a nie tylko pojedynczych employer bursts.

changes: Compared with 2026-08-04, the dominant new signal is no longer the DataArt / deepsense.ai / Spyrosoft burst, but a broader board-first cluster around agentic platform architecture, AI consulting, Microsoft-native delivery and security-adjacent AI engineering.
Addepto now looks like a recurring AI/LLM family rather than a single isolated role, and the salary band for Senior AI Engineer (LLMs, Python) is materially clear.
Itransition, EPAM, cloudatus and Team Up dołożyły nowe role, które wyglądają bardziej jak platform / enablement work niż klasyczny model-training lub generic software engineering.
Board mirrors nadal rotują tytuły i lokalizacje szybciej niż canonical employer pages, więc source divergence pozostaje głównym ryzykiem.
risks: Several new roles are visible first on board mirrors, so canonical employer pages may lag or never appear.
Salary and availability can drift quickly, especially on board-only cards.
Addepto has overlapping role families, so duplicate suppression needs to stay strict on title plus company plus URL.
recommendedActions: Re-check Addepto, Itransition, EPAM, cloudatus and Team Up on the next heartbeat for expiry and salary drift.
Track whether the new board-first cards gain canonical employer pages.
